en: A black-and-white postcard showing a large historic building with three stories, likely from the late 19th or early 20th century, positioned on a gentle hill. The building is surrounded by trees and a well-kept lawn, with a bench and wooden fence in the foreground. The photograph is framed by large tree trunks and branches. Visible text 'Barmen 7/8 20' is along the left edge of the image.
